capabilities: Add comments to note text as CriticMarkup
Accept or reject suggestions in place or all at once
List comments, suggestions and highlights in a sidebar
Place pins on canvas for spatial feedback
extras: Makes no network requests and has no client-side telemetry. Identities can be added by hand in data.json, which is reloaded on change, so an agent can self-register. Includes a relay-comments skill that teaches agents to use CriticMarkup and watch notes for comments.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to leave inline comments or tracked suggested edits on note text and review them with collaborators.

relations.evidence: Relay Comments brings Google-Docs-style review to Obsidian.
Relay Comments integrates with Relay and Obsidian Sync to provide user identity.
Relay Comments integrates with Relay and Obsidian Sync to provide user identity.

summary: Adds Google-Docs-style comments and suggested edits to Markdown notes as CriticMarkup, with a sidebar to review and resolve them.
